notes: ACCEPT MESSAGE COUNT updates the CD's message count item 'to indicate the number of complete messages that exist in the queue structure' named by SYMBOLIC QUEUE through SUB-QUEUE-3 (§1985:XIV.3.1.4 GR1); the feature is REMOVED from 2023 and the compiler keeps the Communication module for 85. CommunicationBinder#BindAcceptMessageCount binds an input CD's area, CommunicationEmitter#Emit calls MessageControl.AcceptMessageCount, and MessageControlSession#AcceptMessageCount reads the four names (CommunicationArea#QueuePath), finds the node and stores the complete messages of its whole subtree (McsTables#CompleteMessages) plus those partly received by live run units (MessageStoreState#PartlyReceivedFrom) into the 6-digit count (SetMessageCount), setting STATUS KEY 00, or 20 with the count unchanged for an unknown structure. Probes at 85 on queue A {B {M1 M2, D {M4}}, C {M3}} and empty E: A 000004, A B 000003, A B D 000001, A B D Z / A blank-S1 D / blank queue / unknown NOPE status 20 with the count left at 777777, E 000000, A after DISABLE INPUT 000004. Refused: an I-O CD, a data-name, no COUNT, two cd-names, no cd-name, ON EXCEPTION and END-ACCEPT (2002 forms). The witnesses count A/B/C before and after a RECEIVE and a message received in two portions.
